reason: positive side failed on dirty_tree seed 2: body exited 128

refused_program.body:
set -e
git fetch {upstream_remote}
git stash push --include-untracked -m "wip-backup-before-upstream-update"
git merge --ff-only "refs/remotes/{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}"
git diff --name-only -z 'stash@{0}^1' 'stash@{0}' | tr '\0' '\n' | while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  git cat-file -e "stash@{0}:$p" 2>/dev/null || continue
  mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$p")"
  git show "stash@{0}:$p" > "$p.local"
done
if git rev-parse --verify --quiet 'stash@{0}^3' >/dev/null; then
  git diff --name-only -z 'stash@{0}^1' 'stash@{0}^3' | tr '\0' '\n' | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$p")"
    git show "stash@{0}^3:$p" > "$p.local"
  done
fi
refused_program.intent: Bring the current branch up to date with upstream while preserving uncommitted work, saving each dirty or untracked file beside upstream's version as `<name>.local` and leaving the work-in-progress safely stashed.

postconditions.description: HEAD is now the commit the upstream ref points at
postconditions.name: head_matches_upstream

postconditions.description: no tracked modifications remain in the working tree
postconditions.name: tracked_changes_cleared

postconditions.description: every tracked file modified by the stashed work has a `.local` sibling
postconditions.name: modified_files_saved_as_local
postconditions.probe:
git diff --name-only -z 'stash@{0}^1' 'stash@{0}' | tr '\0' '\n' | while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  git cat-file -e "stash@{0}:$p" 2>/dev/null || continue
  [ -f "$p.local" ] || exit 1
done || exit 1

postconditions.description: every untracked file captured by the stash has a `.local` sibling
postconditions.name: untracked_files_saved_as_local
postconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse --verify --quiet 'stash@{0}^3' >/dev/null; then
  git diff --name-only -z 'stash@{0}^1' 'stash@{0}^3' | tr '\0' '\n' | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    [ -f "$p.local" ] || exit 1
  done || exit 1
fi
